summary: Preserved candidate PR 612's five multimodal metric families and corrected the independently reviewed bypasses from PR 650. Processor latency is now measured at the common dispatch used by overriding processors, with explicit coverage for MiMoV2's custom async processing paths. A reusable media-load observer now covers the base loader plus specialized Moss, MiMo image/audio/video, and Inkling URL loading paths while preserving absent download values and finally-based error observations.

remaining_limitations: No model weights were downloaded and no full model server was started. The exact candidate failure and corrected dispatch were exercised with the real supported MiDashengLM processor class and bounded fake processor input.

The specialized media regression executes the real Moss normalization and timing path with a bounded fake downloader. MiMo and Inkling wiring was import-, lint-, and source-validated without unavailable model-specific weights.
No native, C++, FlyDSL, or LLVM files changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
